validation.privacy: content, author metadata and reachable objects checked; no prior repository history included

historical_case: examples/continuous-use.md summarizes prior developer observations; original private histories are not distributed

verified: real git commit rejects growth in a later process
existing hook executes and is restored
repeat enable does not duplicate rules
rule additions outside managed block survive uninstall
existing override and Claude instructions handled
fresh clone can reactivate tracked installation
new overriding instruction file is reported
persistent_activation.boundary: instruction files are persistent context, not enforced semantics; POSIX ordinary Git checkouts tested

development_workflow: main-only development; local pre-commit budget; post-push CI; no force pushes or main deletion

conversation_guidance.change: standing instructions are followed silently; actual new messages determine new user intent

live_check.task: Read first.txt then second.txt and return the result

conversation_guidance.limits: one fresh-session smoke test; no before/after causal trial and no claim that the original long-context trigger has been located
